title: Ben Hill Griffin Stadium
scope: The existing pre-renovation Ben Hill Griffin Stadium at Florida Field, with the west skybox stack, uncovered grandstands, stepped north and south decks, two entrance spirals and the playing field.
limitations: The model depicts the stadium before the announced future renovation.
Mapped plan and surveyed grade set the placement. Stand heights, individual seat count, roofing divisions and glazing are approximate. Painted field graphics are shown at model scale.
